title: firing-blowup
description: The local structure of the closure flow at a firing mu in a settling: the firing morphism comparing the predecessor value with the actual value at mu, considered as an object of the arrow category Arr(Val(C)), together with the local combinatorial data that determines it up to isomorphism.

predecessor.description: v^{->mu}, the firing predecessor: the immediate predecessor v_alpha for a successor mu=alpha+1, or the directed colimit colim_{sigma<mu} v_sigma (pointwise knowledge-order sup in FOUR) for a limit mu; the value the trajectory approaches from below at mu

value.description: v_mu, the actual cell-valuation at mu

firingMorphism.description: iota_mu : v^{->mu} -> v_mu in Val(C), defined cell-wise as the knowledge-order increment iota_mu(c): v^{->mu}(c) -> v_mu(c) in FOUR; the blowup IS this morphism viewed as an object of Arr(Val(C))

nonTrivial.description: true iff iota_mu is not an isomorphism (some cell c has v^{->mu}(c) != v_mu(c)); for limit ordinals this is exactly the non-Scott-continuous-firing condition

incidencePattern.description: pi_mu = { c : iota_mu(c) is not the identity }, the set of cells that acquire new value at mu; |pi_mu| measures the breadth of the firing

firingType.description: tau_mu, the firing-type function: for each c in pi_mu records the bilattice increment kind T (truth-side), F (falsity-side), or top (consistency failure / full top-firing); mu is truth-only, falsity-only, or a top-firing accordingly

consistencyFailurePattern.description: gamma_mu = {(c,s) : c in pi_mu, tau_mu(c)=top, s=v^{->mu}(c) in {bottom,t,f}}, recording the source state of each cell that becomes top; empty for non-top firings

localDataComplete.description: the triple (pi_mu, tau_mu, gamma_mu) completely determines Bl_mu(v) up to isomorphism in Arr(Val(C)) (blowup classification theorem)
